proof_summary: The proof derives a five-residue closed form: for each block indexed by \(q\), the five terms are \((-1)^qF_{5q},\,(-1)^qF_{5q+1},\,(-1)^qF_{5q+1},\,0,\,(-1)^{q+1}F_{5q+3}\). Standard Fibonacci recurrence identities show that this formula satisfies the defining fourth-order recurrence and initial values; splitting by the index modulo five then makes the absolute-value conclusion immediate.
